test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Rahul speaks fluently English / although he makes / quite a lot of mistakes /while writing.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Rahul speaks fluently English .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The segment **"Rahul speaks fluently English"** contains a grammatical error.
 
• The correct placement of the adverb in this sentence would be **"Rahul speaks English fluently"**.
 
• This is because the adverb **"fluently"** should modify the verb phrase **"speaks English"**, and it is conventionally placed after the object of the verb.

Correct sentence: *Rahul speaks English fluently, although he makes quite a lot of mistakes while writing.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adverb placement rules:**
 
 
• **Adverbs of manner** (e.g., fluently, quickly, slowly) are typically placed at the end of a sentence or clause.
 
• For example:
 
 
• She sings beautifully. (Correct)
 
• She beautifully sings. (Incorrect)
 
 
 
 
 
• **Common errors with adverbs:**
 
 
• Adverbs should not disrupt the natural flow of a sentence. Placing them incorrectly can lead to confusion or awkward phrasing.
